_meta.concept: Idle support grip on the handguard, re-authored through hand_pose.digit_quaternions
_meta.placement: The approved Idle_LeftHand_B hand sat with its palm heel 6.9 mm inside the handguard wood. viewmodel_v2 lifts SupportHand off the wood: roll about the hand's long axis (+Y) by roll_about_hand_y_deg around pivot_hand_local (palm centre), then translate by offset_along_palm_normal_m against the palm normal. The arm chain turns about the shoulder so the wrist follows; SupportHand takes the new orientation exactly. Searched (fit over roll/pitch/offset) for the most palm contact within 2.5 mm with every palm vertex at least 0.6 mm outside the wood.
_meta.why: The shipped idle flexed the thumb MCP/IP about bone +X, a sideways bend (residual 24.5 deg at L_thumb.02, 13.3 at L_thumb.03), abducted the pinky 25.5 deg (limit 20) and put the palm heel inside the wood.
_meta.fit: Digits re-fitted against the rifle surfaces at the new placement: every digit vertex at least 0.5 mm outside, distal pads about 0.8 mm off the wood, contact on the pad rather than the side (middle 75% pad), ring/pinky DIP about 0.5 x PIP, thumb pad lying along the near side of the handguard (distal and proximal pads within 2.1 mm) with the CMC off its extension limit and pronated, not supinated. Residual side-bend/twist is 0 by construction.
_meta.pinky: Pinky mcp_abduct clamped to 19 deg (was 20.0000005, at the hand_pose.validate limit).
